evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any special instructions concerns or stresser about moving in general that you want me to take note of at this time?" — asked after item/oversized/fragile/box/parking probing was already done
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer's follow-up was a logistics question ("does it usually just take a day") and context about being away in Alabama, not a personal concern — no-concern-raised exception applied
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "we only charge in every fifteen minutes" (beats-it-pay-less) + truck-size-uncertainty range framing with an offer to adjust from photos (window) — two of five lines present

top_strength: Correctly scoped the job (unload-only, since Einstein doesn't run the interstate leg) and set clear expectations upfront about what the crew can and can't do (assembly yes, wall-mounting no) before quoting.
coaching_note: No quid pro quo framing at all before diving into profile verification and item probing — a quick "let's get a few details so I can give you an accurate quote" up front would set expectations for the call length on an already-complex interstate handoff.
